newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CSN H1 net profit up 121 percent.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CSN H1 net profit up 121 percent.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN) has posted the following half-year results.
Note: All figures in Brazilian reais and adjusted for inflation. The figures represent a 121 percent increase in net profit.
CSN said the increase was due to a 22-percent increase in domestic sales volume, a 25-percent reduction in production costs, and lower depreciation costs.
Net profit according to Brazilian generally accepted accounting principles was 171.8 million reais in the first half of this year, up 65 percent from 104 million reais last year.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
